title: custom:poster-card-pro
description: One entity (or none) as a poster, drawn the way its kind says: the icon and the badges on top, the name, the large value and the visual at the bottom. The kind is detected from the entity (its domain, then its device class) or set with `kind`; the entities it reads besides the card's own are its `inputs`; an appliance's `running_above` and a trend's `series` sit on the card; none of them decides the kind. Two places say what the card draws: `icon` and `visual`, each a thing with its options, false, or left out for the kind's. Strings containing {{ }} are Jinja templates rendered by Home Assistant (name, secondary, icon, color, value, status, an image's src).

kind.description: What the entity is, forced or one that is never detected (trend, grid, solar, car, appliance, a named cover or appliance). Left out: detected from the entity's domain and device class; `none` turns every default off

running_above.description: appliance: the power (W) above which it runs

series.description: trend: the series, ids or objects (entity, name, color, rules, visibility)

status.description: The status in the corner: a text or a template, or false for none. Default: the matching rule's status, else the kind's. Its look is the card's: a tag in its colour

badges.description: The badges in the corner, in this order. A badge without an entity reads the poster's: its attribute, else the poster's value

visual.description: The visual: behind the texts (glow, image, flow, and a kind's cover, path or line), or below them (a plot of the history, a bar, a gauge, segments, the sun's day; a weather's sparkline is its forecast); false for none. Left out: the kind's

ruleKeys.description: A rule's keys, its icon left to the card's rule (the poster's, the tile's)

color.description: The card's colour while the rule matches (wins over the card's `color`)

icon.description: The icon while the rule matches

status.description: The status while the rule matches: the tile's line, the poster's status badge. A text: a word such as Off or No is quoted ("Off")

posterRule.description: First matching rule wins, in the order written. Its colour and icon win over the card's; its icon and visual merge onto the card's as the places do (an object without type changes options only)

posterKeys.description: The poster's item: an entity's keys, less the icon and the visual, which are the card's places

icon.description: The icon: an icon's name (mdi:…, a template), { type: icon | image | flow, … }, or false for no icon. Left out: the kind's. A name makes the place an icon, and is a default: a matching rule's icon wins

color.description: The card's colour. A default: a matching rule's colour wins. Template allowed

hover.description: Home Assistant's hover and press, as on its tile card: a light layer under a mouse, a ripple from where you press, a ring around the card while it has the keyboard's focus. false keeps it still

control.description: The control. Left out: the kind's. auto: the kind's, else the domain's (an input_select's select, a script's button); a control's name; false for none; or { type, position, attribute, step, options, confirm }. An object without type changes the kind's own controls (control: { step: 10 })

controlThing.description: The control and its options. Without type they change the kind's own controls

type.description: The control drawn (without type: the kind's own, its options changed)

position.description: Where the control sits: at the end of the line (a poster's: beside the value), or in a block under it. The icon's own actions are icon: { tap_action, hold_action }

iconPlace.description: The icon: an icon's name (mdi:…, a template), { type: icon | image | flow, … }, or false for no icon. A name makes the place an icon (over a photo or an animation too). Left out: the kind's (a person's photo, the wind's animation)

ruleIconPlace.description: The icon while the rule matches: an icon's name, { type, … } or options to merge, false for none; no actions

iconOptions.description: The icon's options, whatever it draws: type: icon (an icon: name, ring, style), image (a picture: src, ring, style, and name: the icon while there is no picture) or flow (the kind's animation: variant, style; wind and rain only); and the icon's own actions. Without type its options merge onto what the place draws (the kind's icon, the card's in a rule); with a name it is an icon

type.description: icon: an icon; image: a picture in the icon's circle; flow: the wind's or the rain's animation

name.description: icon: the icon's name (mdi:…, a template). Default: the entity's. image: the icon while there is no picture

ring.description: icon, image: a ring of the value (min to max) around it

style.description: circle (default) or plain (no circle), whatever the icon draws

variant.description: flow: the animation's drawing, wind: dots, lines, swoosh, vectors; rain: drops, ripples, fill

src.description: image: an image URL, a template that renders one, or an entity whose picture it shows. Default: the card's entity's picture

tap_action.description: Run when the icon is tapped; toggle is the card's own (a lock locks or unlocks, an alarm panel arms or disarms, the rest switch). Default: none, a tap on the icon is the card's (a tile's icon toggles a light, a switch, a fan …)

hold_action.description: Run when the icon is held, a filling ring confirms it. Default: toggle on a lock and an alarm panel (none when it wants a code), else none

double_tap_action.description: Run on a double tap of the icon

iconThing.description: The poster's icon: its thing, options and own actions (a poster's icon has no badge: its corner has the badges)

ruleIconThing.description: A rule's icon: as the card's, without the icon's actions (a rule changes the look, not what a tap does)

visualPlace.description: What fills the card besides the icon and the texts: a thing's name, { type, … } with its options, or false for nothing. Left out: the kind's (a light's glow, the sun's day, a cover's drawing)

visualThing.description: The visual's thing and its options. Without type its options merge onto what the place draws (the kind's visual, the card's in a rule)

type.description: Behind the texts: glow, image, flow, and what only a kind draws (cover, path, line). Below them: sparkline, columns, strip (the history), bar, gauge, segments (the value), sun (the sun's day). A trend's sparkline is its series, a weather's its forecast, unless it plots another entity (src)

src.description: image: an image URL, a template that renders one, or an entity whose picture it shows; sparkline, columns, strip: another entity whose history it draws

opacity.description: image: how much of the picture shows through its shade, 0 to 1 (default 0.3)

tint.description: image: the colour of the shade over the picture. Default: the card's surface

blur.description: image: blurs the picture, a number of px; true is 20, false a sharp picture

variant.description: flow: the animation's drawing, wind: dots, lines, swoosh, vectors; rain: drops, ripples, fill. cover: the window's drawing, shutter, blind, curtain, garage, gate, awning, window. strip: timeline (below the texts, with its times) or edge (a ribbon along the card's bottom edge). Default: the kind's (a cover's device class's, a door's or motion's strip: edge)

hours.description: sparkline, columns, strip, sun: the window in hours (a weather's sparkline: the hours ahead), or today (since midnight). Default: 24

bucket.description: sparkline, columns, strip: a bucket's minutes (default 60)

smoothing.description: sparkline: the averaging bucket in minutes (default: one point per 12 px)

ruleVisualPlace.description: The visual while the rule matches, as the card's visual; a rule sets no hours, bucket or smoothing, nor a plot's src (the history is the card's)

oneFlow.description: The animation is drawn in one place: icon or visual, not both

color.description: The badge's colour, a default: a matching rule's wins. Template allowed

rules.description: Colour, icon, value, pill and pulse by value or state; first match wins. Left out: the kind's colours

kind.description: The kind whose colours the badge takes (left out: the entity's; none: no kind)

format.description: How the value is written: as the entity formats it, in W / kW / MW, as a duration (1h 12m) or as the time from now of a date (in 38 minutes)

stale_after.description: Grey with its age when the entity has not reported for this long

badge.description: A badge: an icon, its name and value, a visual after it and a switch, in its pill (an outline pill unless a style is set)

input.description: An entity id, or false for none (left out: found on the entity's device, or a weather entity's attribute)

typeKeys.description: The keys each kind takes (another kind's are not allowed), and the kinds that draw a kind's own thing (flow, sun, cover, path, line)

inputs.description: The entities the kind reads besides the card's own, by their names: each an entity id, or false not to look for one on the entity's device. Left out: found on the device, or a weather entity's attribute

direction.description: wind, rain: the direction sensor (degrees or a compass point)

wind.description: rain: the wind speed that slants the drops

power.description: battery: its power, + charging; plug: the power it draws

charging.description: car: charging (a binary sensor, or power: on above 0)

remaining.description: an appliance (washer, dryer …): the time left, a duration or when it finishes

phase.description: an appliance: its phase (an enum, a select: Washing, Rinsing …), shown as its status

badgeIcon.description: The badge's icon: an icon's name (mdi:…, a template), { type: icon | image | dot, … }, or false for none. Without type its options change the icon below it (a rule's src the badge's picture)

type.description: icon: an icon; image: a picture (src, else the entity's); dot: a dot in the icon's place

name.description: icon: the icon's name. image: the icon while there is no picture

ring.description: icon, image: a ring of the value (min to max) around it

src.description: image: an image URL, a template that renders one, or an entity whose picture it shows

badgeVisual.description: What the badge draws after its value: bar (the value from min to max), sparkline (the history), trend (how much it changed), or false for none

hours.description: sparkline, trend: the window, hours back or today (since midnight). Default: 24 for a sparkline, 1 for a trend

badgeControl.description: A switch in the badge (toggle), or none (false); the badge keeps its own tap

badgeRule.description: First matching rule wins, in the order written: its colour, icon, value, pill and pulse win over the badge's

value.description: The text in place of the value, in the rule's colour. Template allowed

style.description: The pill while the rule matches
